# Zuhaib Ahmed — Full Stack Developer & AI Engineer

> Zuhaib Ahmed is a Full Stack Developer and AI Engineer based in Sindh, Pakistan,
> and the founder of AIVIZED. He builds AI SaaS platforms, multi-agent automation
> pipelines, RAG systems, and Next.js web applications for clients in the United
> Kingdom, United States, and Pakistan. Around five years of experience.

- [AI Lead Engine](https://zuhaib.aivized.com/portfolio/ai-lead-engine): Four-agent outreach pipeline processing 100 leads per job
